# Vizag Taxi Hub

> Private cab service in Visakhapatnam (Vizag) for local trips, airport transfers, outstation rides and sightseeing tours. Fares are for the cab. Hotel stays, meals and sight tickets are extra.

## Book a cab

- [Home](https://vizagtaxihub.com/): Check a fare and book
- [Local taxi](https://vizagtaxihub.com/local-taxi): City rides by the hour
- [Airport taxi](https://vizagtaxihub.com/airport-taxi): Visakhapatnam airport pickup and drop
- [Outstation taxi](https://vizagtaxihub.com/outstation-taxi): Intercity cabs from Vizag
- [Fleet](https://vizagtaxihub.com/fleet): Sedan, Ertiga, Innova and tempo traveller

## Tours

- [All tours](https://vizagtaxihub.com/tours): Sightseeing packages from Vizag
- [Araku Valley day tour](https://vizagtaxihub.com/tours/araku-valley-tour): Same-day Borra Caves and Araku
- [Araku 2 days 1 night](https://vizagtaxihub.com/tours/araku-valley-package-2d-1n): Overnight in Araku, return the next day
- [Vizag North City Tour](https://vizagtaxihub.com/tours/vizag-north-city-tour): Simhachalam Temple, Yarada Beach and Dolphin's Nose (3:00 PM–5:00 PM)
- [Vizag South City Tour](https://vizagtaxihub.com/tours/vizag-south-city-tour): RK Beach, naval museums, Tenneti Park, Kailasagiri, Rushikonda and Kalimatha Temple
